selection_reason: Next event chronologically after the fixed Bahrain development pilot; selected before download or scoring
scoring: One-step prediction of each next eligible observation within driver/stint, accounting for lap gaps. Not necessarily the immediately next race lap.
primary_selection_metric: Mean Gaussian negative log predictive density on Bahrain after warmup
baseline_interval_fit: Gaussian residual RMS estimated only from Bahrain forecasts after warmup
nuisance_interpretation: Conditional tyre slope = net slope + assumed fuel/track pace improvement. Assumptions are illustrative, not measured.
quality_control: Use existing retrospective eligibility flags without pace-based outlier removal. As-of flag availability is not established.
scope: Single held-out race feasibility test, not broad generalisation or causal strategy evaluation
